title: sRGB → ACEScg matrix validation (oiiotool colour-convert baseline)
purpose: Reusable test for the sRGB-to-ACEScg linear transform that oiiotool --color-convert relies on (documented in art_01M6AF14NGG2M0VFR3DSDY50R0 r1). Provides a numpy-only baseline to confirm matrix correctness and roundtrip error before wiring up an OCIO config or oiiotool invocation. Use as a pre-flight check: if roundtrip error exceeds 1e-6 the matrix is wrong before you ever touch the pipeline.
attribution: Matrix: ACES S-2014-003 (public Academy specification, primaries AP1)
Documentation source: AcademySoftwareFoundation/OpenImageIO commit 0008a6f0, summarised in art_01M6AF14NGG2M0VFR3DSDY50R0 r1
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
